question: What does ERR-4031 mean?
reference: ERR-4031 means the API token is valid but lacks the required scope, for example a read-only token calling a write endpoint.

question: I'm getting ERR-4090 when updating a ticket, what should I do?
reference: ERR-4090 is a conflicting update: another request modified the same ticket, so re-fetch the ticket and retry with the latest version.

question: How many API requests per minute can a Growth workspace make?
reference: Growth workspaces are limited to 700 API requests per minute.

question: What happens when I exceed the API rate limit?
reference: The API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header giving the number of seconds to wait.

question: Do bulk endpoints count differently against the rate limit?
reference: Yes, bulk endpoints such as /tickets/bulk count as 10 requests each.

question: Can I get my money back on an annual plan?
reference: Annual subscriptions get a full refund within 30 days of the initial purchase; after that, refunds are prorated only when cancellation is due to a documented SLA-breaching outage.

question: Are extra AI credit packs refundable?
reference: No, add-on purchases such as extra AI credits are non-refundable.

question: How long does the password reset link stay valid?
reference: The password reset link expires after 15 minutes.

question: Why is the Forgot password link missing for me?
reference: If the workspace uses SAML single sign-on, passwords are managed by the identity provider and the Forgot password link is disabled; contact your IT administrator.

question: Which plan do I need for SAML SSO?
reference: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan.

question: Does signing in with Google let me deprovision users centrally?
reference: No. Google sign-in uses OpenID Connect social sign-in, which does not let admins enforce login policies or provision and deprovision users centrally; that requires SAML SSO and SCIM on Enterprise.

question: Is SCIM provisioning supported?
reference: Yes, SCIM 2.0 provisioning for automatic deprovisioning is supported on the Enterprise plan.

question: I lost my phone and my 2FA backup codes, how do I get back in?
reference: A workspace admin can reset your 2FA from Settings > Team. If you are the only admin, contact support with proof of account ownership; recovery takes up to 2 business days.

question: How do I verify that a webhook request really came from Acme?
reference: Verify the X-Acme-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body computed with your webhook secret.

question: What happens if my webhook endpoint keeps failing?
reference: Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours, then the webhook is automatically disabled and admins are notified by email.

question: How long are closed tickets kept on the Growth plan?
reference: Closed tickets are retained for 3 years on Growth.

question: Can I recover a ticket I deleted last week?
reference: Yes, deleted tickets stay in the trash and can be restored for 30 days before being permanently purged.

question: How long is the export download link valid?
reference: The export download link is valid for 7 days.

question: Can we host our data in the EU?
reference: Yes, Enterprise customers can choose data residency in the European Union (Frankfurt) at workspace creation; existing Enterprise workspaces can be migrated during a maintenance window of up to 4 hours.

question: What service credit do we get if uptime drops below 99%?
reference: If monthly uptime falls below 99.0%, the service credit is 25% of the monthly fee.

question: Is the Growth plan covered by the uptime SLA?
reference: No, Starter and Growth are best-effort and are not covered by the uptime SLA; only Enterprise includes the 99.95% commitment.

question: How do I set first reply time targets for my customers?
reference: Create SLA policies (Growth and Enterprise), which match tickets by conditions such as priority and set first-reply and resolution targets in business or calendar hours.

question: Where do I paste the chat widget code?
reference: Copy the snippet from Settings > Channels > Chat and paste it before the closing body tag on every page where chat should appear.

question: Our replies from Acme are going to customers' spam folders. How do we fix that?
reference: Add Acme to your domain's SPF record and publish the two DKIM CNAME records shown in Settings > Channels > Email.

question: What is the difference between triggers and automations?
reference: Triggers run immediately when a ticket is created or updated and matches conditions; automations run hourly on a schedule and act on time-based conditions such as pending for more than 48 hours.

question: Do unused AI credits carry over to next month?
reference: No, included AI credits do not roll over; purchased credit packs never expire.

question: How much does a pack of extra AI credits cost?
reference: Additional AI credits cost $25 per pack of 1,000.

question: What happens to my workspace if my card payment fails?
reference: Acme retries on days 3, 5, and 7; if all fail, the workspace becomes read-only for a 14-day grace period and is then suspended. Updating the payment method triggers a new charge and restores access.

question: Do I get credit when I remove agent seats mid-cycle?
reference: No, removing seats takes effect at the next renewal and no credit is issued for the remainder of the current period.

question: Can I add tax ID to an invoice I already received?
reference: No, past invoices cannot be reissued with a new tax ID; add it in Settings > Billing > Company details before the next invoice is generated.

question: Can agents use live chat in the mobile app?
reference: No, live chat is not supported in the mobile app.

question: Can we send the audit log to Splunk?
reference: Yes, on Enterprise the audit log can be streamed to a SIEM such as Splunk or Datadog through the audit log API.

question: What happens to our data after we close the account?
reference: All workspace data is permanently deleted 30 days after closure; during those 30 days the owner can reopen the account by contacting support.
